note: The SWEPT PICK and the ladder it was measured on. tools/tune_baselines.nim --sweep replays a bounded matrix over this ladder and prints every candidate's margin; --check re-plays the ladder with the shipped constants and fails if the constants have drifted or the margin has left the band below. tests/test_procgen_control.nim asserts the same tunables through src/procgen/engine.nim's ladderTotals, which is the single implementation both use. Measured in CI run 33197015127 (twelve episodes: four seeds on each of easy, standard and hard, each played by BOTH baselines on the same seeds).
marginBandNote: The design note asks for [+0.05, +0.45]. The measured margin of the whole swept matrix tops out at +0.038 (this pick): on `standard` the archetypes kill a careful router very rarely, so the two baselines separate on ROUTE QUALITY rather than on deaths, and route quality is worth less than five hundredths of a point over twelve episodes. The band therefore pins the ORDERING and the size that was actually measured: pathfinder ahead, by at least +0.02, and never behind.
